Hair Color Pattern - Natural Gradient Ha.description:
🌈 Hair Color Pattern: Hair Color Pattern - Natural Gradient Hair
A subtle, organic gradient between natural-looking shades — roots to tips shifting in a way that mimics sun-lightened hair.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Hair Color Pattern - Natural Gradient Ha.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Apply the selected secondary hair color using a natural gradient hair pattern. If no secondary hair color is selected, keep the pattern subtle or skip it rather than inventing an unrelated color.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
